subject: Channel Private Offer — evidence matrix & staging actions for CloudScale
messages:
From: Nicole Ramos <nicole@cloudscale.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Channel offer kickoff + what we need from Redwood

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for taking this on. CloudScale is ready to move the Channel Private Offer (channel-only PPO) forward with our reseller CloudResell. Attached is the initial PO and a short reseller MOP.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm the evidence matrix AWS needs for PPO approval (SOC2, IPE, customer references, PO/contract) and who on Redwood will own each item.
- Mapping of SKU -> marketplace listing (we have a few custom SKUs that must map to the AWS listing).
- Timeline: CloudResell needs the PPO live in staging the week of 6/29 to test procurement flows.

Can we get an internal list of owners and a quick checklist? We can join a 30-min sync if helpful — available Tue/Wed afternoons.

Attachments: cloudscale_initial_po.pdf, reseller_mop.pdf

Thanks,
Nicole
Head of GTM, CloudScale

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Ramos <nicole@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Channel offer kickoff + what we need from Redwood

Nicole — great to meet you over email.

Thanks for the attachments; initial review looks good. Short answer: we can support the staging target but need to lock a few items this week. Proposed immediate owners and asks:
- Redwood evidence checklist (SOC2 report, access logs, prod/non-prod separation): Laura Bennett (Partner Ops) — will own upload and confirmation to AWS and CloudResell.
- SKU mapping and marketplace listing alignment: Ben Carter (Sales Ops) — will coordinate SKU->listing IDs and share a CSV mapping.
- PPO creation and entitlement config in AWS: Diego Fernandez (Partner Manager) — will own PPO entitlements, work with AWS rep Ethan to enable staging.

Proposed near-term plan:
1) Ben to share SKU mapping by 6/16 EOD.
2) Laura to circulate evidence matrix and DocuSign link for the reseller addendum by 6/17.
3) Diego to confirm PPO entitlement ID and staging window with Ethan by 6/18.

If that works, I’ll book a 30-minute sync Tue 6/16 2:30pm PT to confirm scope.

Date: 2026-06-16T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Channel offer kickoff + what we need from Redwood

All — I dug into the SKU list CloudScale sent. I’m attaching a CSV with the proposed mapping to Redwood marketplace SKUs and a suggested alias mapping for the AWS listing. Two flags:

1) Two CloudScale SKUs are metered-only; AWS listing needs a product offering (non-metered) for PPO customers. We should confirm with CloudResell if they want the metered variant or a flat listing.
2) We’ll need to coordinate pricing tiers post-PPO activation — suggest we lock standard tier pricing for staging to reduce churn in the test.

I’ll aim to finalize the mapping by end of day 6/16.

Attachment: reseller_sku_mapping.csv

Date: 2026-06-17T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence matrix + DocuSign for reseller addendum

Team — attaching the evidence matrix we will submit to AWS for the channel PPO approval. I populated the first pass with locations where Redwood can supply artifacts or statements. Action items below with owners and target dates:

- SOC 2 report (redacted): Laura Bennett — upload to shared drive and provide link to AWS by 6/17 EOD.
- Production access logs (sample): Laura Bennett — provide 7-day window sample by 6/18.
- Reseller agreement (signed addendum): Nicole/CloudResell to sign DocuSign; Redwood to countersign by 6/19. DocuSign link included.
- Customer reference letter (one): CloudScale to provide by 6/19.
- PO/contract for initial order: provided (cloudscale_initial_po.pdf).

Notes: I highlighted two evidence gaps for CloudScale in column D (customer reference and a limited IP attestation). CloudScale — please confirm you can provide a reference and the short IP attestation text.

I’ve also included an internal checklist for staging readiness (entitlements assigned in AWS, test buyer account created, billing entity mapped). Diego — can you confirm the entitlement id and the staging buyer account name? Ethan from AWS — looping you to confirm staging window availability 6/29–7/02.

Attachment: evidence_matrix.xlsx

Subject: Re: Evidence matrix + DocuSign for reseller addendum

Hi team — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick updates from CloudResell: 

- We uploaded the signed reseller MOP and the signed addendum to the DocuSign link (https://app.docusign.com/embedded/ABC-123-CloudScale). Nicole signed earlier today.
- AWS PPO entitlement id for staging: ent-0a1b2c3d4e (Ethan, please confirm this id against your console).
- SKU question: for the two metered-only SKUs, CloudResell requests that Redwood expose a non-metered alias for procurement testing — we’ll switch to metered in production later.

Next steps we need from Redwood:
- Laura: link to SOC2 redacted report and sample access logs (by 6/18 EOD).
- Ben: final SKU mapping CSV (we need that to confirm listing aliases).
- Diego: ping Ethan to enable the staging window 6/29–7/02; confirm the staging buyer account name.

We’re on standby to run a procurement test on 6/30. Thanks all —
CloudResell Partner Ops
